content: Many problems in NLP are treated as sequence to sequence tasks with solutions built on seq2seq-attention based models. While these models perform very well on standard datasets and also appear to capture some linguistic structure BIBREF5 , BIBREF6 , BIBREF7 , they also can be quite brittle, typically breaking on uncharacteristic inputs BIBREF8 , BIBREF1 , indicating that the extent of linguistic generalization these models achieve is still somewhat lacking.
